simple.meaning: תָּעָה (tâʻâh) appears 51 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a brother in the family line and in connection with kingship.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Genesis, Exodus, 2 Kings, 2 Chronicles, Job, and 8 more, beginning at Genesis 20:13. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family, kingship, wilderness, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to תָּעָה (H8582) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows תָּעָה through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
simple.summary: תָּעָה (tâʻâh) / H8582 is tracked through Genesis 20:13, Genesis 21:14, Genesis 37:15, Exodus 23:4. The entry is generated from source alignment, occurrence evidence, and the surrounding Scripture context.
